title: Distance and spectral shape
question: Does SA(3 s)/SA(0.3 s) grow with distance from the rupture?

issues.text: Far stations sit more often on soft basins (Los Angeles, Central Valley) that amplify long periods.
issues.fix: Join Vs30 per station (ShakeMap 4 lists carry it) and add it as a second predictor.

issues.text: Stations cluster (Los Angeles); neighbours share path and site.
issues.fix: Read the interval as optimistic; check the trend per distance bin (shape step).

alternatives.question: Does SA(0.3 s) decay faster with distance than SA(3 s)?
alternatives.why: Drill down: the attenuation step fits κ per period.

alternatives.question: Does a smaller earthquake (M6.4 foreshock) have a lower long/short ratio at the same distance?
alternatives.why: Expand: the source spectrum's corner period grows with magnitude.

hypotheses.statement: ln(SA(3 s)/SA(0.3 s)) increases with distance from the rupture.
hypotheses.null: The ratio does not change with distance.

concepts.label: Spectral shape ratio
concepts.description: ln of SA(3 s)/SA(0.3 s) per station.

concepts.label: Site amplification
concepts.description: Vs30, the top-30 m shear-wave speed.

strategy.detail: USGS Vs30 grid, or a ShakeMap 4 station list that carries vs30, joined on station.

data.source: USGS global Vs30 / ShakeMap 4 station list

method.summary: Regress ln_long_short on distance_km over the stations; the trend step gives the least-squares slope as a factor per 100 km.

steps.title: Fetch the ShakeMap station list
steps.detail: ci38457511, ci version: pga, psa03, psa10, psa30 per channel.

steps.title: Per-station spectra
steps.detail: stations step: larger horizontal per measure, long_short, ln_long_short.

steps.title: Fit the trend
steps.detail: trend step: per_100km_factor, r; shape step per distance bin.

steps.title: Accept or reject H1
steps.detail: Then add Vs30 and repeat for the M6.4 foreshock.

caveats: One earthquake; magnitude also shapes the spectrum.
